```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readODS)
```

```{r}
scores <- read_ods(
  "../data/raw/wimd-2025-index-and-domain-scores-by-small-area.ods",
  sheet = "Data",
  skip  = 3
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(4:12, as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.[[1]]))

cat("Loaded:", nrow(scores), "rows |", ncol(scores), "columns\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(names(scores))

```

```{r}
scores  %>%
  pivot
```
